summary.text: Qiao Zhi Cai is Qiao clan's first supreme elder in the Southern Border, whose signature immortal killer move wooden statue murder is used to frame him after Wu clan deaths at blood tide pit.

claims.text: At blood tide pit, Wu Yong finds Wu Yuan Ju and Rong Hao dead as wooden statues and links the method to Qiao Zhi Cai. Qiao clan Gu Immortal Qiao Zhi Cai rushes to the scene as Qiao clan’s first supreme elder. Narration states wooden statue murder is his signature immortal killer move: hit souls crumble and disperse, bodies turn to wood, and remaining life force can grow trees. He denies the killings, claims a frame, and cites Qiao clan and Wu clan’s long relationship. Wu Yong says he is willing to trust him because of marriage connections and alliance, and that the frame is too obvious; he has already invited Tie Mian Shen.

Tie Mian Shen arrives before Qiao Zhi Cai and Wu Yong, inspects the corpses, and declares it was not Qiao Zhi Cai. He says someone mimicked wooden statue murder and points to a Seven Illusions Demon Immortal as the method’s source.

Qiao Si Liu reports that Qiao Zhi Cai went with Wu Yong to investigate the deaths of Wu Yuan Ju and Rong Hao and has vanished along with him, his life tablet Gu broken and Qiao clan unable to reach him.

In the purple blood river formation fight, Wu Yong stays uninjured with spare energy to cover Tie Mian Shen and Qiao Zhi Cai farther out. Qiao Zhi Cai shouts that the formation has phantom path effects and that ruin bat corpses must be cleared or those effects will not end. After Wu Yong brings out Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building, jade dew resolves Qiao Zhi Cai’s crisis; he praises the building and flies in beside Wu Yong, saying they will not lose and only need time to escape.

Word reaches Fang Yuan that Wu Yong did not die and that Qiao Zhi Cai and Tie Mian Shen are alive too, only trapped for the time being while they try to reach the battlefield with an Immortal Gu House.

Inside Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building at Plunder Shadow Earth Trench, he exclaims at the shadow monsters gathered by a super Gu formation while Wu Yong observes and orders the Immortal Gu Houses to attack.

When Feng Jiu Ge’s destiny song ends and the battlefield wakes, Qiao Zhi Cai has a pale face and lingering fear, saying that if the song had not stopped none of them would have gotten free and they would have been hit badly.
